note: GFP recreation area on Angostura Reservoir 10 mi SE of Hot Springs off US-385/18. Four campgrounds spread along the west shore: Cheyenne by the north entrance, Cascade 2 km south behind a long sand beach, and Hat Creek and Horsehead near the south entrance. The beach-side sites (Cascade's west row 26E-44E, Hat Creek 98E-101E) look over the sand to the water. Camping cabins in every campground; marina, restaurant and lodges run by the Angostura Resort concession; swim beaches, boat ramps, fish cleaning station, visitor center. --Claude
